glossary_assessments.entry: - [**encoding:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Establishing a population activity pattern from an input.
glossary_assessments.reason: Short action definition matches its contrast with decoding.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**excitatory input:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the models used here, an input that increases a receiving neuron's tendency to fire.
glossary_assessments.reason: Receiving cell and direction of effect are explicit; keep model scope.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**inhibitory input:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the models used here, an input that reduces a receiving neuron's tendency to fire.
glossary_assessments.reason: Receiving cell and reduced firing tendency are explicit; keep model scope.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**neuron:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A signaling cell in the nervous system.
glossary_assessments.reason: Everyday signaling-cell phrase supplies the family without anatomical detail irrelevant here.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**retina:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.
glossary_assessments.reason: Location plus light sensitivity supplies exactly the role needed for image motion.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**hippocampus:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A brain region involved in memory and navigation.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**dendrite:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A branching input structure of a neuron.

glossary_assessments.entry: - [**path integration:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Updating an estimate of position from movement.
